findings.summary: No minors were found on site during the audit; age checks at the gate were incomplete.
One shaft lacked wall supports; protective equipment was issued during the audit.

corrective_actions.action: Introduce documented age verification at every pit entrance.
Install wall supports in the remaining shaft and re-inspect.

conclusion: Supply may continue under the corrective action plan; re-audit within six months.
